analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($73.82) vs SMA5 ($77.53)/SMA20 ($79.00)/SMA50 ($74.61): below, indicating short-to-mid term bearish trend.
· Position vs SMA100 ($74.54)/SMA200 ($64.53): mixed long-term trend, confirmed long-term support above SMA200.
· 52-week position (71.9%) + current price level is 16% below 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (57.5 → 42.6): entering oversold territory, confirming slowdown in decline.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.4473 → -0.9370): turned negative and continues to worsen, in a bearish convergence phase.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $72.98): approaching lower band, volatility expansion with 15.22% band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($70.96): confirmed support based on no new 5-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($74.18): short-term resistance zone, potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: sideways range, lacking clear trend pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.48x): move has conviction, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis: entered oversold territory during downtrend, confirming potential short-term bounce. Positioned at 1x target allocation, considering leverage on signal strengthening.
